description: The CH-47F hit-points LOD holds only the engine, four windscreens and a light, so the hull, both rotors, the avionics and the fuel named in config never take damage. Add hull points from the fuselage fire geometry (damagehide), rotor points from the two rotor fire-geometry parts, avionics points at the artificial-horizon needle axis on the instrument panel, and fuel points along both sponsons (1.6 m out, 2.4 m down, 3 m forward to 2 m aft; add-selection-points takes ODOL order x, up, aft), named for the config hitpoints (trup, velka vrtule, mala vrtule, elektronika, fuel tanks). Remove this manifest when CUP ships a CH-47F hit-points LOD with those selections.
